faq_en.q: What are the exact dimensions of {primary_keyword}?
faq_en.a: KeXinMaterials {primary_keyword} comes in 9 standard sizes (WL1204 through WL5020), with outer dimensions ranging from 120×90×40mm (smallest) to 500×400×200mm (largest). Inner dimensions are typically 5mm less on each side to accommodate wall thickness. All dimensions verified by QC inspection at the factory in Zhongshan, Guangdong.

faq_en.q: What weight can each size hold?
faq_en.a: Load capacity scales with size: WL1204 holds up to 5kg, WL2005 up to 12kg, WL3812 up to 30kg, and WL5020 up to 80kg static load. We validate load capacity through pressure testing at our factory — every batch is sampled at 1.5× rated load for 24 hours before shipping.

faq_en.q: Are the dimensions metric or imperial?
faq_en.a: We publish both. Outer dimensions in mm (millimeters) and inches (e.g., 380×320×120mm = 14.96×12.60×4.72in). Inner dimensions follow the same dual-unit convention. Custom sizes available — we have 60+ machines and accept non-standard molds with MOQ 500.

faq_en.q: What's the difference between WL models in the same size range?
faq_en.a: WL1905, WL2005, and WL2305 are all 'Medium' size (~190-230mm outer length) but differ in width and depth. WL1905 is square (190×190), WL2005 is wider (195×170), WL2305 is balanced (230×180). The 0.5-1.0mm dimensional differences determine what fits — we help you choose during the 12h quote consultation.

faq_en.q: Can I get custom dimensions?
faq_en.a: Yes. Our factory has 60+ machines and 12 production lines, and we've delivered 150+ custom sizes since 2014. Custom molds: 30-day lead time after design approval, MOQ 500 units, $3,000-8,000 mold fee (waived for orders >5,000 units). Send your 3D model to kexin@beeaa.com for an instant feasibility check.

faq_en.q: Is your {primary_keyword} rating real or marketing?
faq_en.a: All IP ratings are third-party tested by SGS, TUV, or Intertek at our lab in Zhongshan, Guangdong. We test every new mold design to IP67 (submersible 1m / 30 min) and select models to IP68 (submersible 5m / 30 min). Test certificates are dated and serialized — we provide them with every shipment upon request. 96-hour salt spray testing per ASTM B117 is also standard for outdoor models.

faq_en.q: What does MIL-STD-810H mean for {primary_keyword}?
faq_en.a: MIL-STD-810H is the US Department of Defense test standard for environmental engineering. Our cases pass Method 501.7 (high temperature +70°C), Method 502.7 (low temperature -40°C), Method 514.8 (vibration), Method 516.8 (shock / 26 drops at 1.2m), and Method 506.6 (rain / water penetration). Used by armed forces in 30+ countries including USA, UK, Germany, France, Japan, Korea, Israel.

faq_en.q: What certifications do you hold?
faq_en.a: Current certifications for {primary_keyword}: ISO 9001:2015 (Quality Management), ROHS (EU hazardous substance), CE (European Conformity), FCC (US electromagnetic), IP67 / IP68 (Ingress Protection), MIL-STD-810H (US DoD environmental), UN 3480 (LiPo battery transport for drone cases), WHO PQS pre-qualification (for medical cases), REACH (EU chemicals). All certificates renewed annually and available as PDF.

faq_en.q: How do you test {primary_keyword}?
faq_en.a: We run a 5-stage QC protocol: (1) 100% surface resistance / dimensional check on every unit. (2) Drop test: 26 drops at 1.2m on concrete, then water-submersion test. (3) Temperature cycle: -40°C to +80°C, 12 cycles. (4) Latch cycle test: 5,000 open/close cycles. (5) Pressure valve cycle test: 1,000 cycles. Lot certificates and test reports are traceable by serial number, available on request for any batch shipped.

faq_en.q: What's the difference between IP67 and IP68?
faq_en.a: Both protect against dust (6 = dust-tight). IP67 = submersible to 1m / 30 minutes. IP68 = submersible beyond 1m (typically 3-5m) / continuous immersion. IP68 cases cost ~15% more due to reinforced seals and pressure valves. For most consumer use (camera, drone, tools), IP67 is sufficient. For diving, marine research, or extended water exposure, IP68 is recommended. KeXinMaterials offers both, with the IP68 version tested to 5m / 30 min per IEC 60529.

faq_zh.q: 你们 {primary_keyword} 防护等级是真的还是营销？
faq_zh.a: 所有 IP 等级都由 SGS、TUV、Intertek 在我们中山实验室第三方测试。每一款新模具设计都按 IP67（1 米/30 分钟潜水）和部分型号 IP68（5 米/30 分钟潜水）测试。测试证书有日期和序列号 — 应要求随每次发货提供。户外型号还做 96 小时盐雾测试（ASTM B117）。

faq_zh.q: MIL-STD-810H 对 {primary_keyword} 意味着什么？
faq_zh.a: MIL-STD-810H 是美国国防部环境工程测试标准。我们的防护箱通过 Method 501.7（高温 +70°C）、502.7（低温 -40°C）、514.8（振动）、516.8（冲击 / 1.2m 26 次跌落）、506.6（雨 / 水渗透）。30+ 国家军队使用，包括美、英、德、法、日、韩、以色列。
{primary_keyword} 当前认证：ISO 9001:2015（质量管理）、ROHS（欧盟有害物质）、CE（欧盟合规）、FCC（美国电磁）、IP67 / IP68（防护等级）、MIL-STD-810H（美国国防部环境）、UN 3480（LiPo 电池运输 — 无人机防护箱）、WHO PQS 预认证（医疗防护箱）、REACH（欧盟化学品）。所有证书每年更新，可提供 PDF。
5 阶段 QC 流程：(1) 每件 100% 表面电阻 / 尺寸检测。(2) 跌落测试：1.2m 混凝土上 26 次跌落，再做水浸测试。(3) 温度循环：-40°C 至 +80°C，12 循环。(4) 锁扣循环测试：5,000 次开合。(5) 压力阀循环测试：1,000 次。批次证书和测试报告可按序列号追溯，任何批次发货时都可应要求提供。

faq_zh.q: IP67 和 IP68 有什么区别？
faq_zh.a: 两者都防尘（6 = 完全防尘）。IP67 = 1 米 / 30 分钟潜水。IP68 = 超过 1 米（通常 3-5 米）/ 持续浸泡。IP68 防护箱因加固密封和压力阀，成本高约 15%。多数消费场景（相机、无人机、工具）IP67 已足够。潜水、海洋研究或长时间水浸建议 IP68。客信新材料两者都提供，IP68 版本按 IEC 60529 测试至 5 米/30 分钟。

faq_en.q: What certifications do I need to import {primary_keyword} into my country?

We provide all relevant certificates as PDF with each shipment.

faq_en.q: What HS code does {primary_keyword} use?
faq_en.a: Standard HS code for {primary_keyword} (plastic protective case): 3923.10 (Articles for the conveyance/packing of goods, of plastics) or 4202.92 (plastic travel goods). For specific industries: 9002.11 (camera lens), 8802.11 (drone), 9302.00 (military). We declare accurately per buyer's destination to avoid customs delays.

faq_en.a: Sea freight: 18-25 days to USA West Coast, 28-35 days to USA East Coast, 22-28 days to EU (Rotterdam/Hamburg), 15-20 days to Southeast Asia, 25-30 days to Middle East, 30-38 days to South America, 12-18 days to Japan/Korea. Apply at kexin@beeaa.com with your business registration and target market.
